#+title: Regenerate the stale ER diagram and gate it
#+description: projects/ores.sql/modeling/ores_schema.puml is a generated artifact (banner: GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT, regenerate with ./projects/ores.codegen/plantuml_er_generate.sh) and it is a month stale. Its last commit was 6610f847fd on 2026-08-07. Regenerating it today produces 2069 changed lines and a 3 MB PNG growth, almost all of it unrelated drift: the trading bond wave, refdata catalog changes, and the marketdata classification work. No CI gate covers it, so nothing catches the drift. The market_series.is_scalar column and the market_observation.point_id nullability were deliberately left undocumented in the diagram by the point-model change set rather than dragging that month of drift into it. Work: regenerate the diagram once, wire the check into the drift gate so it cannot go stale again, and consider dropping the tracked PNG and cmapx in favour of build-only output.
#+type: capture
#+level: cross
#+filetags: 
#+created: 2026-09-17
#+updated: 2026-09-28

This page is a [[id:671F18E4-E09C-4B3B-BD24-D33DF8AE38A6][capture]] in the *inbox=* bucket of the product backlog — a pre-sprint idea, not yet pulled into a sprint as a story.

* What

Measured again on 2026-09-28, from a change that needed one line of it.
Making `ores_dq_portfolios_artefact_tbl.is_virtual` boolean leaves the diagram
still saying `integer`. Regenerating it produced 1127 changed lines that are
not the timestamp: the account table still carries its retired two-line
summary where the create script now carries the generated header and a
four-line description, and column order disagrees with the create script. So
the choice is to drag unrelated drift into a change about a flag, or to
hand-edit a generated file, or to leave the diagram wrong. This change left it
wrong and recorded the fact here.

That is the third measurement of the same drift: 26 hunks (BE48603C), 2069
lines (this capture, 2026-09-17), 1127 lines (2026-09-28). The numbers differ
because they were taken at different times and count differently, but the
finding does not: a generated artefact no gate covers cannot be kept current,
and each change that touches the schema has to decide again what to do about
it.

* Why

See the description above: gate the generator, or drop the tracked
=puml=/=png=/=cmapx= in favour of build-only output, which the earlier
measurement already proposed.
